223180.websiteDescription:
Introducing a powerful, compact and waterproof LED torch ideal for a multitude of safety, outdoor and general lighting applications. Light is supplied via a single high power LED to provide a super bright white light with an intensity greater than 150 candela (commonly 180 candela over five hours). Manufactured to ISO18813-2006 standard this waterproof torch is powered by a single AA battery (included, plus spare) which provides a minimum constant operating time of seven hours. For additional safety a Morse code signal can be operated to flash a minimum of 180 times per minute by gently depressing the soft touch rubber on/off switch when the torch is on. Lightweight and fully waterproof this torch floats lens up and high out of the water and includes a comfortable, generous wrist strap for added security. All items supplied including torch, spare AA battery and spare LED bulb are contained within a compact robust plastic storage case with hinged lid for convenience. Manufactured to the highest standard these compact torches are extremely robust, fire and oil resistant, mould proof, corrosion proof and U.V. resistant. This torch is supplied as standard equipment in BLA safety packs 226505, 226509 and 226529. 
Features 
• High intensity minimum 150 candela LED light 
• Will operate continually for a minimum of 7 hours 
• Waterproof, floats, compact design 
• Morse code ability greater than 180 times per minute 
• Manufactured to ISO Standard 18813-2006 
• Includes case, spare battery and spare LED bulb
